title: Cross-team Engineering Leadership Weekly Staff Notes - 2026-04-13
content:
Attendees: Ava Martinez (owner), Liam Chen, Priya Kapoor, Diego Alvarez, Maya Singh, Rachel O'Neil, Ben Carter

Date: 2026-04-13
Location: Zoom / #eng-leadership huddle

Agenda:
- Quick wins & highlights
- Incidents / reliability updates
- Dedicated capacity + autoscaler status
- Private deployments onboarding
- Console / observability rollout timeline
- Model catalog + kernel selection regressions
- Action items / blockers

Notes:
1) Quick wins
- Continuous-batching perf tweak deployed to staging (PR #324) shows ~12% p50 latency improvement for 2k token seqs. Data from perf runs attached in linked artifacts.
- Maya completed Canary rollout framework for model variant fallback; initial tests look good, will enable for 2 models next week.
- Customer-facing latency dashboard prototype in Console (beta) demoed to Product; positive feedback.

2) Incidents / Reliability
- Small degradation reported on 2026-04-10 in us-west serving pool when autoscaler misapplied burst policy; root cause: race condition in capacity reconciliation (JIRA-RT-987). SRE/Infra patched with hotfix v1.2.1; monitoring alerts tightened.
- Action: Diego to lead post-mortem doc by Fri 2026-04-17; include checklist for manual rollback steps and SLA communication timeline.

3) Dedicated capacity / Autoscaler
- Autoscaler improvements (alpha) rolled to dedicated pools; initial telemetry shows smoother scale-up but occasional overshoot when concurrent spike > 400 QPS.
- Need to tune weight for priority-tiered routing to avoid oversubscribe; Liam to run simulation job and propose new heuristics by Tue 2026-04-20.
- Contract renewals: finance asks for capacity forecast for Q3; Product Ops to provide 95th percentile forecast by 2026-04-27.

4) Private Deployments
- Onboarding checklist for enterprise customer ACME Corp in progress. Network team flagged KMS integration gap for HSM-backed keys. Priya to coordinate with Security to confirm timeline (target: 2026-04-30).
- Docs: add troubleshooting section for offline model OCI loads; Diego to draft.

5) Console & Observability
- Rollout plan for token-level cost breakdowns: phased release starting 2026-05-04 to 10% of hosted users; internal beta next week.
- Need clearer UX for per-route tracing; Product assigned to Ben + Rachel to iterate prototype.

6) Model Catalog / Kernel Selection
- Regression: one quantized Llama variant shows 6% token increase in latency on A100 when sequence lengths >1024 due to kernel fallback. Research to evaluate alternative kernel selection heuristics. Maya + Applied ML to produce measurement matrix.
- Add regression alert to Optimize that triggers when unit token cost increases >5% for a model version.

7) Cross-team coordination & open questions
- How to prioritize work between reliability backlog vs. new product rollout? Tentative plan: dedicate 30% sprint capacity to reliability through May; measure via error budget burn.
- Need clearer SLA escalation path for Dedicated customers; Customer Success + SRE to define and publish.

Action items (owners & target dates):
- Diego: Post-mortem for 2026-04-10 incident (due 2026-04-17)
- Liam: Autoscaler simulation + heuristics proposal (due 2026-04-20)
- Priya: KMS/HSM integration timeline & security sign-off for ACME onboarding (due 2026-04-30)
- Maya + Applied ML: Kernel selection measurement matrix + recommendations (due 2026-04-24)
- Ben + Rachel: Console tracing UX prototype (demo 2026-04-21)
- Product Ops: Dedicated capacity forecast for Q3 (due 2026-04-27)

Blockers:
- HSM KMS access delayed by vendor paperwork (blocks Private onboarding)
- Infra test cluster capacity limited for autoscaler sim (Liam working with Release Eng to provision)

Decisions made:
- Enable canary fallback for model variants on two non-production models next week.
- Hold off on wide release of token-cost breakdown until internal beta feedback incorporated.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Revisit batching window defaults for low-latency tiers (Ryan to own; add to next week's agenda)
- Evaluate adding per-tenant cache size limits to avoid noisy neighbors

Links & references:
- Postmortem template: CONFLUENCE-1234
- Incident ticket: JIRA-RT-987
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/324
- Slack thread: slack:#eng-serving-runtime/thread/FFG12345

Next meeting: 2026-04-20 10:00 PT

Notes taken by: Ava Martinez

Unresolved / Notes to self:
- Need to capture latency distribution across model sizes for billing discussions - add to data request to Observability team.
- Check if Dedicated SLA language needs to mention fallback models explicitly.
